trust_decision.summary: Whether a request is rejected is decided by whether each request-part schema was compiled into a validator; schema presence is tested by truthiness at several gates, so the JSON Schema boolean `false` (a valid draft-7 schema meaning 'never valid') is read as 'no schema' and every request reaches the handler unvalidated.

landing_point.why: A reader told that boolean `false` request schemas are skipped finds the literal skip here: `if (schema.body)` is false for the boolean, so no body validator is compiled and `validate()` has nothing to run.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the parallel `!contentProperty[mediaName].schema` check for response content schemas

O8b_injection_room.sibling: `validateSchemaBodyOption` uses `schema?.body` truthiness, so `body: false` on a bodyless method (GET/HEAD/DELETE) is accepted at registration while `body: {...}` is rejected
